page.overview:
Who is Anuidethar Veilthorn?

Anuidethar Veilthorn is a Dark Elf a merchant factor associated with the ship Nightwake, one of the vessels that is part of the fleet of the Black Ark Temple of Spite. Known for his persuasive manner and sharp negotiating skills, Veilthorn leads the ship's trade dealings, combining charm with carefully veiled threats of violence to secure favourable agreements.

Veilthorn often claims that he could sell the Phoenix Crown of Ulthuan to to the Phoenix King Finubar, a boast that reflects both his confidence and his approach to trade. Rather than simply selling goods, he prefers to sell the idea of opportunity itself, promising wealth, comfort, power and influence to those willing to deal with him.

In the social hierarchy of the Dark Elves, merchant factors such as Veilthorn are looked down upon by the highborn. This disdain does not trouble him as long as his dealings continue to make him wealthy. When Dark Elf nobles desire rare or valuable items, they frequently rely on merchants like Veilthorn to obtain them through trade or plunder.

Unlike many of his clients, Veilthorn is a self-made Elf. He began his career in the Naggaroth city of Har Ganeth, selling organs in the streets before gradually rising through trade and negotiation. Over time he built a reputation strong enough to take him across the mortal world, dealing with powerful merchants and influential buyers.
